title: 2013 Content Industry Statistics Survey: Games extract
methodology: KOCCA content-industry statistical survey. Table 4 separates game production/distribution from PC cafes, arcade-game rooms and video-game venues; its values are headcounts in people.
assessment: Decisive primary KOCCA source with a sector label matching KR_core. It recovers 2010 48,585; 2011 51,859; and 2012 52,466, but does not by itself prove survey-frame continuity with the later series.
next_step: Main may validate and add the five proposed pre-2015 observations as a vintage-separated history; preserve the existing post-2015 sources and the core-versus-venue split, and keep trend eligibility false pending methods.

title: 2016 Copyright Protection Annual Report

methodology: Government report reproduces a three-year game-employment table and explicitly credits the KOCCA 2015 White Paper (2015-10). It separates game production/distribution from game distribution/consumption.
assessment: Usable government-hosted reproduction for missing 2013 and 2014 core observations. The direct KOCCA 2015 White Paper file was not recovered in this bounded pass, so provenance is one step removed; the 2012 value matches the direct 2013 KOCCA table.
next_step: If stronger archival provenance is needed, locate the original 2015 KOCCA White Paper PDF. Do not replace the reproduced values unless the original conflicts.
